text:
maria: Quick design review: we're changing bulk-approve in Prompt Sets to a non-modal toast with Undo. also need to update evals/scorecard counts so regression diffs reflect the approval immediately.
kevin: can you paste the mock?
maria: figma: https://www.figma.com/file/xxxx/Bulk-approve-v2. Key pieces: toast top-right, brief animation, Undo button, and a small pill on the scorecard header that says "12 approved" for the run.
asha: a11y: do not move focus to the row when the toast appears. toasts should be announced via aria-live and not trap keyboard. also if the approval changes scorecard state we need an SR-friendly announcement about score changes.
tom: question about timeline: should the scorecard pill be persistent or transient? if persistent, it can confuse users unless it links to the diff.
jessica: UX suggestion: make the pill focusable and link to the regression diff panel. label: "12 approved (view changes)". that makes the path clear.
evaluator-bot: New eval run 2026-04-01 12:02 created for prompt-set: conversational-sales.
kevin: implementation note: current bulk-approve flow removes items and then shows a modal. I'll refactor to update the list in-place and emit an analytics event approval.bulk with {count, actor, ids}. we should add an event for scorecard.update too.
maria: microcopy debate: "Approved 12 prompt sets" vs "12 prompt sets approved". which reads better in a one-line toast?
rachel: prefer verb-first: "Approved 12 prompt sets. Undo". keeps action-first and consistent with other toasts.
asha: screen reader detail: use role="status" aria-live="polite" aria-atomic="true" on the toast. include an offscreen sentence for score changes: "Scorecard updated: 3 regressions introduced, 0 resolved." if we show the pill, it should have an aria-describedby pointing to that message.
kevin: okay. for keyboard, Tab should reach the toast Undo button, Enter activates undo, Esc closes toast and returns focus to the previously focused element (usually the bulk action toolbar). we'll add tests to assert focus return.
tom: acceptance criteria: 1) toast announced via aria-live, 2) no focus trap, 3) keyboard accessible Undo, 4) scorecard pill links to regression diff, 5) analytics events emitted for bulk-approve & scorecard-change.
maria: also add copy guidance: sentence case, short, and include agent name? e.g., "Approved 12 prompt sets by Maria" — probably unnecessary, skip for now.
jessica: also consider persistence: toast auto-dismiss after 6s, but Undo stays focusable until dismissed. pill persists until user dismisses or navigates away.
rachel: small performance ask: when approving lots of prompt sets, batch server calls to avoid N request storms. kevin, can you implement batching?
kevin: yes, will batch by 50 and show a progressive count in the toast (e.g., "Approved 120 of 300...") if it's long-running. progressive announce to SRs is tricky; we'll only announce final result and keep interim visual updates.
asha: for SR tests: steps: (1) run NVDA/VoiceOver, (2) select 3 prompt sets, (3) trigger bulk-approve, (4) assert that screen reader reads: "Approved 3 prompt sets. Press Undo to revert.", (5) Tab to Undo and press Enter to confirm revert and ensure announcement "Reverted 3 prompt sets". include Esc path too.
deploy-bot: UAT updated with branch feature/bulk-approve-toast-for-testing.
maria: thanks — assigning implementation to @kevin, SR test writing to @asha, UX follow-up to @jessica. will review after UAT.
